instrumentation.memory: Toolhelp recursive owner/descendants, QueryWorkingSet Shared=0 resident pages, PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS_EX.PrivateUsage
instrumentation.webview: CDP on ephemeral localhost port; independent textqa identifier; SHIYE_DATA_DIR; double-gated profile fixture selection
instrumentation.idle: profile_unload simulates expiry for performance only; the separate functional smoke verifies real 60-second expiry
instrumentation.wakeEndpoint: Budget uses native show to frontend_ready, matching the existing native-benchmark.mjs method; launcher-to-editable is separately reported

raw.method: Toolhelp owner + recursive descendants; PSAPI QueryWorkingSet non-shared resident pages; GetProcessMemoryInfo PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS_EX.PrivateUsage; failed child queries count as zero only after a previously opened SYNCHRONIZE handle signals termination
raw.terminationProof: WaitForSingleObject(handle,0) returns immediately; WAIT_OBJECT_0 proves a process object is signaled, which Microsoft documents as termination. SYNCHRONIZE is sufficient; QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION is not a substitute for wait rights. Failed OpenProcess, including error 87, is not proof and remains invalid. Owner failures always remain invalid.
